title: MGTS Taksofon Moscow Payphone Token, Russia - Exonumia
descriptionText:
MGTS Taksofon – Moscow Payphone Telephone Token (Jeton) – Russia
You will receive the exact token pictured. These are photos of the actual item, not stock images. Both faces are shown, plus angled shots so you can see the relief and edge.
What it is
A telephone token used in public payphones operated by MGTS – the Moscow City Telephone Network (Moskovskaya Gorodskaya Telefonnaya Set). Tokens like this were dropped into street payphones in place of coins. They were retired once phone cards and mobile phones took over, which is why they now turn up as collectibles rather than currency.
Markings
One face: TAKSOFON (Russian for payphone) arced across the top, MGTS across the bottom, with a raised circular boss in the centre and two small raised dots flanking it
Other face: the stylised geometric MGTS monogram, with the letters MGTS running along the lower edge
No date or denomination is struck on the token
Material and size: brown moulded plastic, approximately 20 mm in diameter. MGTS taksofon tokens of this type were produced in plastic rather than metal. Please see the photos for the surface and colour as they are now.
Period: reference catalogues date MGTS payphone tokens of this design to roughly 1993–2003, the years they were in use in Moscow. The token itself carries no date.
Condition: Used, in the condition shown. This token circulated, and shows handling consistent with that. Please review all photos closely and judge for yourself – the images are of the actual token and are the most accurate description of its condition.
